text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear no-position from the start and end","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states its stance plainly and keeps that stance consistent throughout."},{"evidence":"\"someone could get hurt very badly\" and \"I don't wanna get hurt or die\"","quality":"argumentative force","description":"The essay uses stronger, more direct claims about risk to press its case against driverless cars."},{"evidence":"\"what if it brakes or dose not function right\" and \"the car watrches you too\"","quality":"reasoning development","description":"The essay expands its opposition with multiple reasons rather than just stating an opinion."},{"evidence":"\"vibrating seat or flashing lights\" followed by \"what if it brakes\"","quality":"counterargument response","description":"The essay acknowledges a benefit from the article and then explains why that safeguard is still not enough."},{"evidence":"\"So my argument with this is no\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a clear closing statement that restates the main position."}]}
